name: Fastmail
author: Ninepoint Labs
description: Unread email from your Fastmail Inbox and the folders your rules file into, live over JMAP push, with new-mail notifications — through fm-cli.

barWidget.description: Unread count and recent email from Fastmail across linked accounts and folders, updated as it changes.

schema.label: Folders
schema.description: all: the newest Inbox threads plus unseen email from every other folder (shown in the panel as All folders). inbox: the Inbox only (Inbox only).

schema.label: Exclude folders
schema.description: Comma-separated folder names or paths left out of the all view, such as Newsletters, Other Services/Gmail. Junk, Trash, Drafts, Sent, Snoozed, Scheduled and Archive are always left out.
